title: Use Dreamina Seedance 2.0 Fast (free trial) to quickly test...
content:
Use Dreamina Seedance 2.0 Fast (free trial) to quickly test and iterate on social media clip generations.  
Reference an existing clip and select only specific elements (e.g., trending transitions, viral action beats) to extract, so Seedance learns just those parts and you can recreate the style without copying the entire clip.
description:
it’s finally here: Dreamina Seedance 2.0 is now live on Dreamina after months of anticipation.

here’s a quick step-by-step guide to use it for your social media clips:

quick note before you get started, the official name is Dreamina Seedance 2.0.

early access is already open, so there’s no waitlist or queue to worry about.

on top of that, Dreamina Seedance 2.0 Fast is available for free trial, which makes it even easier to jump in.

it’s also performing at the top level right now ranked #1 in both T2V and I2V on Artificial Analysis.

the standout feature for social creators is the ability to reference and extract specific elements: trending transitions, viral action beats, you name it. 

the AI only learns the exact parts you select, so you can recreate trending styles without copying entire clips.

I tested this with a trending reel format and was able to generate a polished, on-trend sequence from a single prompt.

if you’re constantly chasing trends but don’t have time to rebuild edits manually, this fits really well into your workflow. It’s efficient, consistent, and speeds up content production.

try it now: https://t.co/dK2DD7bbbn

ja.title: Dreamina Seedance 2.0 Fast（無料トライアル）を使用して、ソーシャルメディアクリップの生成を迅速
ja.content:
Dreamina Seedance 2.0 Fast（無料トライアル）を使用して、ソーシャルメディアクリップの生成を迅速にテストおよび反復します。  
既存のクリップを参照し、特定の要素（例：トレンドのトランジション、バイラルなアクションビート）のみを選択して抽出し、Seedanceがその部分だけを学習するようにします。これにより、クリップ全体をコピーすることなくスタイルを再現できます。
---

ko.content:
Dreamina Seedance 2.0 Fast (무료 체험판)을 사용하여 소셜 미디어 클립 생성물을 빠르게 테스트하고 반복하세요.  
기존 클립을 참고하여 특정 요소(예: 트렌딩 전환, 바이럴 액션 비트)만 선택하여 추출하면 Seedance가 해당 부분만 학습하여 전체 클립을 복사하지 않고도 스타일을 재현할 수 있습니다.

pt-BR.title: Use o Dreamina Seedance 2.0 Fast (teste gratuito) para testa
pt-BR.content:
Use o Dreamina Seedance 2.0 Fast (teste gratuito) para testar e iterar rapidamente na geração de clipes para redes sociais.  
Faça referência a um clipe existente e selecione apenas elementos específicos (por exemplo, transições em alta, batidas de ação viral) para extrair, para que o Seedance aprenda apenas essas partes e você possa recriar o estilo sem copiar o clipe inteiro.

zh-CN.title: 使用 Dreamina Seedance 2.0 Fast（免费试用）快速测试和迭代社交媒体剪辑生成。
zh-CN.content:
使用 Dreamina Seedance 2.0 Fast（免费试用）快速测试和迭代社交媒体剪辑生成。  
参考现有剪辑并仅选择特定元素（例如，流行的转场、病毒式动作节拍）进行提取，这样 Seedance 只学习这些部分，您可以在不复制整个剪辑的情况下重现风格。
